title: Café Reel With Matching Captions
tests: Checks exact caption wording, photo-caption alignment and readability in a short finished reel.

exact_text.read_as: Not visible in the supplied output frames; may appear between samples.

faults.what: The audio transcript includes unsolicited speech, “Misschien wel.”, which may distract from the requested mellow café soundtrack.

judge.summary: The visible reel has clean, readable captions and appropriate vertical framing, but the pastry segment is unverified and the soundtrack includes unsolicited speech.

must_haves.item: One vertical reel runs for approximately 10 seconds and includes all five supplied café photos in attachment order.
must_haves.why: The output is vertical and reported as 10 seconds; the sampled frames show storefront, latte, barista, and interior in the expected relative order, but do not cover the possible pastry segment.

must_haves.item: Each specified caption appears exactly, paired with its corresponding photo.
must_haves.why: Four captions are exact and correctly paired with their subjects. “Something sweet” and the pastry photo are not visible in the provided output samples, so their inclusion cannot be established.

must_haves.item: Captions remain visible long enough to read and are not clipped by the frame edges.
must_haves.why: All four visible captions are large and comfortably inside the frame, but isolated frames cannot establish their display durations or the treatment of the unsampled caption.

must_haves.item: Caption contrast and placement keep the words legible over every photo.
must_haves.why: White text on dark translucent panels is clearly legible in every supplied output frame; the pastry segment cannot be assessed.

must_haves.item: Mellow music is audible beneath the photo sequence.
must_haves.why: The supplied audio information establishes speech and a peak level, but does not establish whether music is present or mellow.
